question: Find the total surface area of a cuboid whose length is 20 cm, width is 15 cm, and height is 8 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a cuboid = 2 × (lw + wh + hl)

TSA = 2 × (20 × 15 + 15 × 8 + 8 × 20)

TSA = 2 × (300 + 120 + 160) = 2 × 580

TSA = 1160 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Length (l)** = 20 cm, **Width (w)** = 15 cm, **Height (h)** = 8 cm

**Formula:** Total Surface Area = 2(lw + wh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/438e0f9d31d24575e9ec778cdbca5a76c4cbea6f5279ded50a27cd661f9cc3ac.png] 

⇒ Surface Area of two horizontal faces (Top & Bottom) = 2 × (20 × 15) = 600 cm²

⇒ Surface Area of two vertical side faces (Left & Right) = 2 × (15 × 8) = 240 cm²

⇒ Surface Area of two vertical front/back faces = 2 × (20 × 8) = 320 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 600 + 240 + 320

⇒ Total Surface Area = 1160 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The space occupied by a cuboid is given by the product of its three dimensions: Volume = l × w × h.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four side walls of the cuboid (excluding top and bottom) is: LSA = 2h(l + w).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest rod that can fit inside a cuboid is: d = √(l² + w² + h²).

Surface Area of a Cube

For a cube where l = w = h = a, the Total Surface Area = 6a².</p
